Specifically, studies have shown that patients with higher levels of injury severity, such as those requiring ICU care or hospitalization for more than 10 days, are at a higher risk of developing HO.

In particular, the prompt states that "Surrogates of injury severity, including days in the ICU and non-ICU hospital LOS >10 days, were associated with the development of HO in our cohort of acetabular fracture patients." Additionally, prophylactic X-ray therapy (XRT) was found to be significantly protective against HO.

Therefore, it is clear that higher levels of injury severity are correlated with a increased risk of developing heterotopic ossification in fractures of the acetabulum.
